page.title: Sales notebook
page.intro: Take a photo of each page of the notebook kept during the event: each photo is read on its own and its text shows next to it so you can fix it (you can also type a page). Sales are then split following the notebook template in {settings} and compared one by one with the event's orders. Order numbers, prices and payment methods are ignored.
page.analysed: Notebook analysed: {count} sale read. | Notebook analysed: {count} sales read.

report.allMatching: Everything matches: each sale in the notebook has its order, and the other way round.
report.notRecordedTitle: Written in the notebook, missing from the app
report.notRecordedHint: A sale may have been forgotten on SumUp or in the app: add the order to the event.
report.notNotedTitle: In the app, missing from the notebook
report.notNotedHint: The sale was not written down, or it is a duplicate or a mistake.
report.differingHint: The notebook sale matches an order whose items or quantities differ.

template.title: Sales notebook
template.intro: How sales are written in the notebook kept at events: used to split the pages read into sales before comparing them with the orders.

numbered.label: Each sale starts with its number
numbered.description: “12) 2 stickers, 1 print”; following lines without a number belong to the same sale. The number is followed by ), ., -, : or /. Lines before the first number of a page are ignored.

line.label: One sale per line
line.description: Each line is a whole sale; a number at the start of the line is ignored.

gap.label: Sales separated by a gap or a rule
gap.description: The lines of a sale follow each other; a wider gap than usual or a rule (----) starts the next sale.

template.abbreviationsHint: Replaced before recognising products (whole word, case ignored): “stk” → “sticker”, “L” → “Lichen”.
